summary: PREVIEW Phase-3 (Professional Profile OWNERSHIP + Authorized Editors + Affiliations) full backend + frontend regression. Backend: 38/38 pytest passing in new /app/backend/tests/test_professionals_authz.py covering the entire authorization matrix, RBAC on management endpoints, audit meta (edit_source/fields_changed/diff for ADMIN/SELF/AUTHORIZED_ORGANIZATION_EDITOR), high-risk field stripping (linked_user_id/id/source_professional_id/created_by/role ignored on PATCH), link-user safety (409 already-linked, 400 patient, null unlinks and immediately revokes SELF), permission fields on GET single (can_edit/edit_source/management_label/can_manage_editors) and GET list (can_edit per row), organization affiliations lifecycle (bad org 400 / create / list w/ organization_name / delete), and confirmation that affiliation existence alone does NOT grant edit access. Route ordering verified: GET /professionals/authz/user-search resolves as list (not captured as prof_id). Frontend admin UI (/internal/professionals): profile row -> ProfileView shows prof-management-badge ('Admin-managed'/'Self-managed'/'Organization-managed'), admin sees prof-manage-editors + prof-edit; Authorized Editors modal opens (prof-editors-modal), shows prof-editors-empty on empty state, prof-editor-user-search with q='staff' returns prof-editor-search-results, prof-editor-grant-<userId> adds a prof-editor-row to prof-editors-list, prof-editor-revoke-<userId> removes it and restores prof-editors-empty. Physician (PAGUAYO) UI: My Professional Profile card (prof-my-profile-card) + prof-edit-my-profile button visible; opening a profile they have no permission on shows NEITHER prof-edit NOR prof-manage-editors (client hides + server 403 already covered in backend matrix). Cleanup verified: professional_profiles, professional_profile_editors, professional_organization_affiliations all EMPTY at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-admin GET /professionals/{prof_id}/affiliations exists (PROF_VIEW_ROLES) but non-admin cannot create/delete — consider whether staff/physician should even see affiliation history. Not a bug per spec.

PATCH _HIGH_RISK_FIELDS stripping relies on the ProfessionalBody Pydantic model NOT declaring these keys; if the model is later extended to include e.g. linked_user_id for admin flows the strip guard would still remove it — safer to enforce in a dedicated admin-only update endpoint. Currently correct.
GET /professionals list executes an editors lookup only for non-admin users (async find). For large directories this is O(N) but bounded to user's active grants. OK for current scale.
professionals_grant_editor returns the existing doc if a duplicate grant is attempted — silently idempotent; consider a 200 vs 201 distinction, but not blocking.
